name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover the cost of a shattered window replacement?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover the cost of a shattered window replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homeowner's insurance policies cover sudden and accidental damage, which often includes shattered windows. Coverage typically depends on the cause of the damage (e.g., vandalism, storm damage, accidental impact) and your policy's deductible. We recommend contacting your insurance provider directly to understand your specific coverage details. We can provide estimates and documentation to assist with your claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance often covers shattered windows resulting from sudden damage, depending on your policy and deductible. Contact your provider, and we can assist with documentation.
